description: Implementation of ShareAccountWritePlatformService for handling CRUD operations and business logic related to share accounts in Fineract system, including account creation, approval, rejection, activation, shares management, and journal entries integration.

classes.name: ShareAccountWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for handling share account operations, integrating with repositories, serializers, and journal services.

methods.name: createShareAccount
methods.description: Creates a new share account, validates input, saves it, generates account number if needed, creates journal entries, and notifies creation event.

methods.name: updateShareAccount
methods.description: Updates an existing share account based on provided JSON command, handles journal entry reversal if necessary.

methods.name: applyAddtionalShares
methods.description: Handles adding additional shares to an account, saves transaction, updates journal entries.

methods.name: approveShareAccount
methods.description: Approves a share account, updates notes, updates product subscribed shares, creates journal entries, and sends approval event.

methods.name: rejectShareAccount
methods.description: Rejects a share account, updates notes, and creates relevant journal entries.

methods.name: undoApproveShareAccount
methods.description: Reverts approval status of a share account, handles journal entry reversion, updates notes.

methods.name: activateShareAccount
methods.description: Activates a share account, creates journal entries for charge transactions.

methods.name: approveAdditionalShares
methods.description: Approves additional shares purchase, updates subscribed shares, and creates journal entries.

methods.name: rejectAdditionalShares
methods.description: Rejects pending additional shares, updates journal entries accordingly.

methods.name: redeemShares
methods.description: Redeems shares from an account, updates subscribed shares, creates journal entries.

methods.name: closeShareAccount
methods.description: Closes a share account, records notes, creates journal entries for transactions.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity exceptions by throwing an error with a specific message.
